data.one_liner: Extract Flutter translation strings and keys to JSON catalogs with optional AI discovery and translation.
data.what_it_does: Parses Flutter/Dart source files to extract static localization strings and keys into JSON catalogs. It preserves existing translations and keys across runs, and supports optional AI-powered discovery and translation using OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or local models.
use_when: You want to extract hardcoded strings or localization keys into a JSON catalog for your Flutter app.
You use localization libraries like GetX, Easy Localization, Flutter Translate, FlutterI18n, i18n_extension, or Intl.
You want optional AI assistance to discover unmarked text and translate it into multiple languages.
avoid_when: You need automated runtime string extraction or widget rewriting inside source code.
You are strictly prohibited from using third-party AI APIs for content translation.
strengths: Supports multiple popular localization patterns and custom wrapper functions or getters.
Preserves existing translation values and nested dictionary structures on subsequent runs.
Offers optional local or cloud AI discovery and translation with validation of placeholders and markup.
weaknesses: AI-generated translations can make mistakes or require manual review for accuracy and context.
Does not resolve package imports or rewrite source code automatically.
data.setup_notes: Activate via dart pub global activate flutter_string_extractor and run from your project root.
